title: canthium oliganthum
intro: Canthium oliganthum, commonly known as the 'Strychnos' or 'Dog Bone Tree', is a plant species native to tropical Africa. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions. The therapeutic actions of the plant involve its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms such as fever, cough, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Canthium oliganthum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
